criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Set Reminder/Alarm/Notification
categories.definition: User wants to create, check, or manage reminders, alarms, or notifications.

categories.name: Control Smart Device
categories.definition: User wants to control smart home devices like lights, appliances, or adjust audio/device settings.

categories.name: Retrieve Weather/Time/Date
categories.definition: User wants to know the current weather, forecast, time, or date.

categories.name: Retrieve General Knowledge
categories.definition: User wants facts, definitions, information about people, places, or general trivia.

categories.name: Retrieve News/Updates
categories.definition: User wants current news headlines, updates on specific topics, or social media feeds.

categories.name: Local Search/Events/Recommendations
categories.definition: User wants to find local businesses, events, or get recommendations for movies, restaurants, or activities.

categories.name: Retrieve Recipes/Instructions
categories.definition: User wants recipes or how-to instructions for cooking or other tasks.

categories.name: Retrieve Financial Information
categories.definition: User wants exchange rates, stock market updates, or product prices.

categories.name: Retrieve Travel Information
categories.definition: User wants information about train times, flights, or general travel options.

categories.name: Retrieve Calendar/Schedule
categories.definition: User wants to inquire about their upcoming meetings, appointments, or plans.

categories.name: Retrieve List Content
categories.definition: User wants to hear or see the contents of a personal list (e.g., grocery list, to-do list).

categories.name: Manage Communication
categories.definition: User wants to send, receive, check, or reply to emails, messages, or social media posts, or make calls.

categories.name: Control Media Playback
categories.definition: User wants to play, pause, skip, identify, or manage music, podcasts, audiobooks, radio, or videos.

categories.name: Manage Calendar Events
categories.definition: User wants to create, modify, or cancel events in their calendar.

categories.name: Shopping/Ordering/Booking
categories.definition: User wants to purchase items, order food, or book travel/tickets.

categories.name: Manage Lists
categories.definition: User wants to create, add to, or remove items from general personal lists (e.g., grocery, to-do, wishlist).

categories.name: Get Directions
categories.definition: User wants navigation instructions or route information.

categories.name: Note Taking
categories.definition: User wants to save a note, log an event, or record information.

categories.name: Play Game
categories.definition: User wants to start or play a game.

categories.name: General Interaction
categories.definition: User asks personal questions or makes general conversational requests.
